chipintelli_audio_init.tooltip: Start the shared SDK and wait for audio resources, codec, amplifier and playback tasks.

chipintelli_audio_end.tooltip: Clear the completion callback and request playback stop; the shared SDK stays active.

chipintelli_audio_play_voice.tooltip: Play a 16-bit voice ID provisioned in voice.bin.

chipintelli_audio_play_command_id.tooltip: Play a prompt associated with a command ID; option -1 uses the configured default.

chipintelli_audio_play_command_text.tooltip: Look up configured command text and play its prompt; this is not text-to-speech.

chipintelli_audio_play_semantic.tooltip: Play a prompt associated with a 32-bit semantic ID.

chipintelli_audio_stop.tooltip: Submit a playback stop request to the SDK.

chipintelli_audio_set_volume.tooltip: Set volume from 0 to 100; out-of-range values are constrained.

chipintelli_audio_set_muted.tooltip: Preserve the requested volume while muted and restore it when unmuted.

chipintelli_audio_is_playing.tooltip: Check whether a prompt is currently playing.

chipintelli_audio_volume.tooltip: Return the requested volume from 0 to 100.

chipintelli_audio_on_finished.tooltip: The SDK callback only sets a flag; child blocks execute safely from Arduino loop.
